survey: A blue wooden door with an arched top, set in a matching arched orange-wood frame in a cream stucco wall, with ivy growing over the frame. The door fills the frame opening and stands on a stone threshold. Its plank upper section and recessed lower panel face the camera straight on. Two brass hinges sit on the left edge, and a brass knob with a keyhole plate is mounted on the right stile. The handle is on the opposite side from the hinges, so the door can swing. A round leafy wreath with pink, white and yellow flowers hangs flat against the upper door. An orange bow with two tails is tied at the bottom of the wreath. The hook is hidden behind the wreath, which is a normal simplification. The ivy grows from the wall and frame and climbs over the arch.
